description: This file contains PHP functions related to a CRM system, specifically for handling SOAP portal functionalities. It includes functions for retrieving bugs, cases, notes, related modules, user authentication, and session management within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves bug IDs related to specific contacts based on contact IDs.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves bug IDs related to specific accounts based on account IDs.

methods.name: get_cases_in_contacts
methods.description: Obtains case IDs associated with specific contacts.

methods.name: get_cases_in_accounts
methods.description: Obtains case IDs associated with specific accounts.

methods.name: get_notes_in_contacts
methods.description: Fetches notes linked to given contacts, specifically portal notes.

methods.name: get_notes_in_module
methods.description: Fetches notes related to a specified module and parent IDs.

methods.name: get_related_in_module
methods.description: Fetches related records for a given module based on IDs, supporting custom ordering and limits.

methods.name: get_accounts_from_contact
methods.description: Retrieves account IDs linked to a specific contact.

methods.name: get_contacts_from_account
methods.description: Retrieves contact IDs linked to a specific account.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Builds a list of related records based on IDs, conditions, and ordering.

methods.name: build_relationship_tree
methods.description: Constructs a relationship hierarchy for a contact, including associated accounts and related contacts.

methods.name: get_contacts_in
methods.description: Returns session-stored list of contact IDs accessible to the user.

methods.name: get_accounts_in
methods.description: Returns session-stored list of account IDs accessible to the user.

methods.name: get_module_in
methods.description: Returns a session-based list of IDs for a module, used for filtering related records.

methods.name: set_module_in
methods.description: Stores related record IDs into session for a specific module, updating the session's viewable set.
